title: Capricorn: how you love in winter
old_caption: Capricorn loves by showing up early: the shovelled path, the cocoa on the step. It's beautiful. Love goes both ways though, so let them help you too.

title: Capricorn: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Bringing work to the party is very Capricorn. The emails will still be there tomorrow, and this night won't come back. You're allowed to just be here.

title: Capricorn: the gift that means the most
old_caption: Capricorn mentions a goal once and moves on. The gift that gets them? Proof someone was listening. Write down what they said they wanted.

title: Capricorn: one word for the new year
old_caption: Capricorn, your word for next year is rest. Not as a reward when everything's done, but as part of the plan. Rest is what keeps you going.

title: Aquarius: how you love in winter
old_caption: Aquarius loves on long walks, talking about the stars and big ideas. Somewhere in there, notice the cold hand next to you. Hold it, not just the conversation.

title: Aquarius: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Aquarius can say hi to every person at the party and forget who they arrived with. Being social is a gift. Check in with your person first.

title: Aquarius: the gift that means the most
old_caption: Aquarius loves what no one else would think of. Something handmade, a little odd, made just for them, means more than anything off a shelf.

title: Aquarius: one word for the new year
old_caption: Aquarius, your word for next year is warm. Keep the cool, clear mind. Let people see the warm heart under it too.

title: Pisces: how you love in winter
old_caption: Pisces, one glance and you've planned a whole winter together. Daydreams are lovely, but the real person in front of you is even better. Go say hi.

title: Pisces: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Pisces feels everyone's feelings at the holidays and carries them all. You can care deeply without holding it all yourself. Hand some of it back.
